notes.title: The 5th highest-rated game on Steam in 2022 is back with a multiplayer sequel
notes.notes: When you think of the best games of 2022, what springs to mind? Elden Ring. Vampire Survivors. Persona 5 Royal. Marvel's Midnight Suns, Teardown, Card Shark, Monster Hunter Rise, the list goes on... Read more.

notes.title: The First Trailer Is Here!
notes.notes:
Dear Duckies,

We’re pleased to announce that [b]Slowly Sliding Ducks[/b] finally has a proper trailer!

Watch it here, leave a comment, and share it with your duck-loving friends:

[previewyoutube=o8Azr5176iQ;full][/previewyoutube]

To mark the occasion, we’ve also updated the entire Steam page. We hope you enjoy the new screenshots and the more accurate game description. What do you think?

There’s still a lot to do—this is our first time tackling the many challenges of bringing a multiplayer game to life—but we’re happy with where we are right now.

Back to work!

More news soon...
